# Orion Powers

> Software engineer building AI-driven decision-support software for the U.S. Air Force and Navy at Modus Operandi. Computer Science student at the Florida Institute of Technology, graduating December 2026. Based in Melbourne, Florida.

Three professional engineering roles across defense (DoD), SaaS, and applied machine learning. Core areas: full-stack web development (React, Angular, TypeScript, FastAPI), machine learning (Azure ML, local LLMs via Ollama), and hardware prototyping (NFC, 3D printing, laser cutting). A DoD security clearance is in process. This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) convention for AI agents and assistants — for the full interactive presentation, see the homepage.

## Background

- Current role: Lead UI Engineer at Modus Operandi (Oct 2024–present), building DoD decision-support software for the U.S. Air Force and Navy.
- Education: B.S. Computer Science, Florida Institute of Technology, expected December 2026 (110/126 credit hours).
- Location: Melbourne, Florida, USA.
- Contact: orionthanhpowers@gmail.com · +1 (502) 232-8043 · [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/orion-powers)

## Experience

- **Modus Operandi** — Lead UI Engineer (Oct 2024–Present): leads UI engineering across three U.S. Air Force and Navy platforms — PAiGE, POMML, and LOGEN. Selected and flown to Joint Base Langley-Eustis to partner on-site with the Air Force's 363rd ISR Wing analysts. Designed and built a Go.js knowledge graph that makes LLM decisions traceable in real time; hardened mission dashboards with Keycloak RBAC and CAPCO classification markings; delivered 80% test coverage with zero detected vulnerabilities; and led LOGEN's Angular 19→21 modernization. Stack: Angular, TypeScript, FastAPI, Go.js, Keycloak.
- **Hyperformant** — Software Engineer Intern (May 2024–Oct 2024): shipped a production SaaS platform in React/TypeScript; rebuilt the marketing site with interactive 3D (Figma/Spline → Svelte/Webflow). Stack: React, TypeScript, Svelte, Supabase, Webflow, Spline.
- **RARE T Holdings** — Software Engineer (Dec 2022–Jun 2023): built Azure ML models that read and document invoices automatically, doubling pipeline throughput; created autonomous content workflows with the ChatGPT API and Power Automate. Stack: Azure ML, Java, TypeScript, ChatGPT API, Power Automate.

## Programs

- **PAiGE** — U.S. Air Force targeting-analysis platform built on Movia®. It connects entities, relationships, and events across sources with full provenance so analysts can trace judgments back to source. Direct impact: selected and flown to partner on-site with the 363rd ISR Wing; designed and built a Go.js knowledge graph for traceable LLM decisions; hardened dashboards with Keycloak RBAC and CAPCO classification markings; and delivered 80% test coverage with zero detected vulnerabilities. [Product page](https://www.modusoperandi.com/products/paige)
- **LOGEN** — U.S. Navy / Naval Air Warfare Center logistics platform, expanded as “Logistics Enhancement with Living Intelligence.” It maintains a resilient live picture of supply, routes, inventory, and dependencies. Direct impact: led the Angular 19→21 platform modernization. [Product page](https://www.modusoperandi.com/products/logen)
- **POMML** — U.S. Air Force learning-management system. Leads UI engineering for the product interface; further public program and impact details are intentionally withheld until confirmed.

## Projects

- LLM Network Analyzer (2025): upload a packet capture, get a plain-English security briefing — Gemma 2 12B runs fully on-device via Ollama, six anomaly-detection categories, no packet ever leaves the machine. Stack: Python, FastAPI, Scapy, Angular, Ollama.
- BrainBench (Senior Design, 2025–26): benchmarks small local LLMs (Qwen3, Gemma 3, Phi-3) on mathematical reasoning with a matched-subset statistical methodology; presented at the Northrop Grumman Engineering & Science Student Design Showcase; revised into IEEE conference format.
- NFC Business Cards (2023): laser-engraved business cards with embedded NFC chips that open this site on tap — designed, programmed, and finished by hand.
- Also built: a production SaaS platform and a marketing-site rebuild (Hyperformant), an ML invoice processor and an autonomous content workflow (RARE T Holdings), and several 3D-printed prototypes (Fusion 360/CAD).
